frame.physical_scale: One common world/pixel scale calibrated to the existing female SOUTH head width, including ears, at alpha>128. Authored family-scale choice, not a recovered native height.
frame.units: width and center_x are Qud cell-width units (2/3 world); height and center_z are world units. No per-facing rescale.

policy: Authoring assembly of independently reviewed current versions only. Source textures remain intact and immutable; late original-body ownership overlays use their original tint roles. No new drawing, deformation or ImageGen call.

views.south: Mail covers connected shoulders and anterior chest drop. Near horns grow from upper crown; flesh ears remain separate. Only inner fore pair wears boots; outer hind pair stays bare. Right Hand292 is screen-left and covers its low inward blade grip.
views.east: Mail covers upright torso with curved short sleeve; fleece lower trunk remains separate. Crown roots sit above/forward of ear. Near/far fore boots overlap naturally, hind hooves bare. Blade is near, low original palm above handle.
views.north: Original skull hides anterior horn roots. Short dorsal mail ends at horizontal trunk junction. Complete fore boots and right-hand weapon remain behind the original body; visible hind pair stays bare. Right hand is screen-right.
views.west: Body, mail, boots and horn anatomy mirror east. Blade keeps the actually equipped right Hand292 and uses explicit far-side depth, so it is not moved onto the visible left hand. No independent rescaling.

unknowns: Joint/skull/far-palm coordinates and garment tailoring are authored estimates. Source supports fore/hind groups and four actual equipped objects, not an ovine species identity. No tail inferred.
boundaries: Static source-bound generation assembly. Icy Vapor stays native metadata/effect. Resting/ready blade display, equip/unequip, visibility, hurt/look/save and native activation await full-set generation gate.
